boundary: Recorded bibliography and citation-use occurrences, not logical dependencies, endorsements, verified work grouping, or canonical author identities.

normalization.match: Intersect postings within each recorded bibliography record; preserve source order.
normalization.shard: Routes keyed by field-HASH; HASH is SHA256 first byte modulo 64 of field:token. Separate author, text and work namespaces; author/text tokens, opaque work ID.
normalization.tokens: HTML-unescape; NFKC and casefold; unwrap mathbb, mathcal, mathrm, mathbf, text; NFKD and remove Unicode M-category marks; split into Unicode alphanumeric words excluding underscore; deduplicate.
